title: Fourier coefficients of convolution powers
statement: Let $\phi$ be a probability density on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, let $d$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $\gamma$ be a point of that cube. The Fourier coefficient of the $d$th convolution power of $\phi$ at $\gamma$ equals the $d$th power of the Fourier coefficient of $\phi$ at $\gamma$.
hypotheses_covered: $\phi$ is a probability density on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
$\gamma$ is a point of the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
